author: Tism1345
quote: I was really exited but nervous i never expected them to exceed the story and characters of Gta V and IV. But to speed this low and have 13 years for such boring characters is atrocious. Its a slow story where the first half is basically relationship simulator. And then wth is that for a ending this is a game not a movie. Having a “epilogue” where you can redo the last mission over and over is so stupid imo. And then also restricting me from committing certain crimes wtf is that. Utter disappointment. How can they mess this up this bad. I guess its what they deserve for removing dan houser and replacing him with woke feminists who dont even play videogames. Its a boring rom com for boomer women.
